summary: Waldencast plc filed a Form 6-K reporting two routine items: an amendment to a credit agreement that postpones the issuance of warrants to lenders from July 1, 2026 to November 17, 2026, and the FDA approval of a new product, Obagi saypha ChIQ injectable gel. Neither event constitutes a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, going-private transaction, or strategic review. The filing is a routine update on financing terms and a regulatory product clearance without any structural transaction. Therefore, no special-situation category applies.
